acceptance: Pre-cutover parity matrix passes: TPC-H SF 0.01-10 and TPC-DS SF 0.01-10 byte identity, refresh-set parity, Parquet EXCEPT ALL and result_digest.py.
Performance gate passes on macOS arm64 and Linux x86_64 with N=3 medians in the PR body.
Default resolution never depends on installed extras; Windows arm64 resolves to legacy and says so; --datagen-backend legacy still works.
Corpus data_generation_hash export gaps are closed.
context:
Phase 3 Tier 1 cutover of the faster data-generation plan. Separated from Tier 3/SSB cutover and legacy retirement so validated TPC-H/TPC-DS cutover and Owner Decision A2 (Parquet layout default) can land independently.

Parked 2026-11-25 by owner decision: the datagen target is now a BenchBox-owned Rust library (see datagen-adr-rust-library-revision). This item waits for the revised ADR, which decides whether it is rebuilt around the library or dropped.
description:
First cutover (docs/internal/adr/adr-benchbox-datagen.md (revised 2026-11-26, PR #4540), decision 4). Make benchbox-datagen a required dependency on every platform with a wheel (environment markers), switch tpch and tpcds defaults to native, and resolve platforms without a wheel to legacy from a fixed platform table with a visible notice.

Decision gate: owner sign-off on the pre-cutover gate results and on the Parquet corpus re-baseline this triggers (library Parquet has its own writer identity).

Guardrails: no fork of tpcgen-rs; no auto backend mode or silent fallback; Python stays the only manifest writer; heavy measurements only through make heavy-run with N=3 medians recorded in the PR body; budgets from the ADR table are the gate, and a miss goes to the owner rather than being waived.
